name: SCAMPER Ideation
deliverable: Systematic transformation of existing concepts using seven vectors

steps.text: Put an existing concept in front of the room and list the seven prompts: substitute, combine, adapt, modify, repurpose, eliminate, reverse.
Work one prompt at a time, asking what would change in the concept if that verb were mandatory.
Write one concrete variant per prompt rather than a general suggestion, keeping the original visible.
Group the variants by the prompt that produced them so the room sees which vectors yielded most.
Choose the variants worth developing and record the prompt that produced each one.

failure: Half-working looks like ordinary ideas with a verb written beside each: the prompts decorate the output instead of forcing a specific change.
intervention: Take one prompt and make it a constraint: name exactly what is eliminated, reversed, or substituted, and say what breaks as a result.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A seven-prompt creativity checklist used in ideation workshops; no origin given in the source.
